title: Agent channel
body:
The wiring that makes decade more than a compositor. A decade-aware app
talks to decade over a unix socket, and the agent chat drives panes from
what it sees in the agent's ACP session. Nothing here exists yet; decade at
commit 7932094 is a compositor with chrome and one ghostty pane.

Two kinds of pane action, by who intends them:

| Kind | Who drives | Needs |
|---|---|---|
| Follow along | the chat, from typed ACP events | the socket and a code pane |
| Agent-driven | the agent, from an intention a tool call cannot imply | an MCP server exposing decade's verbs |

Follow along is deterministic: each ACP event maps to a pane action by a
fixed rule with no model in the loop. Agent-driven covers the residue, such
as highlighting only the lines that matter or drawing a diagram, and comes
last.

## Pieces

| Issue | Role |
|---|---|
| socket protocol | framing, handshake, pane addressing, the first messages |
| code pane | the first decade-aware client: show a file, go to a line, mark lines |
| follow along | the chat emits pane messages from ACP tool calls and file requests |
| MCP server | decade's verbs as tools the agent can call |

They belong together because each is useless alone and the socket is the
contract between all of them.

## Out of scope

- The chat TUI itself. It is its own repository, unnamed as of 2026-11-06.
- A remote-machine protocol. It rides on the socket once that exists.
